newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil seen $2 down, Brent oil about up 5 cts.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil seen $2 down, Brent oil about up 5 cts.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures are expected to open lower on Thursday, while Brent crude should bounce back from Wednesday's late drop which took it to a new 13-month low, dealers said.

June gas oil is seen opening $2.00 to $2.50 lower from its closing price of $162.25 a tonne while July Brent should match gains in Singapore to move five to 10 cents higher from its settlement price of $17.35 a barrel.
Wednesday's late fall came after speculation of a possible slow start to the next six months of the U.N./Iraq oil-for-food deal appeared to subside, brokers said.
